Common.slogan: Train the words. Understand the commands.
Common.demo: Demonstration drafts — not a verified glossary

Landing.title: Terms that matter need precise understanding.
Landing.lead: TactLex helps you learn military English through short lessons, reviews and a transparently verified bilingual glossary.
Landing.trust: Free · Ukrainian and English · From 5 minutes a day
Landing.programLead: The programme is designed for 200 terms. Only entries that have passed source and translation review appear in the glossary.
Landing.howTitle: One short cycle — from introduction to review.
Landing.step1Text: See the term and context, then hear its pronunciation.
Landing.step3Text: Review mistakes and receive the next review interval.
Landing.safetyTitle: A language trainer, not operational guidance
Landing.safetyText: We do not publish classified material, combat instructions or medical advice in place of certified training.
Landing.ctaText: Choose a field and learn at your own pace.
Landing.footer: A learning project for precise understanding of terminology.

Auth.loginLead: Continue from where you left off.
Auth.registerLead: You only need an email, password and nickname.
Auth.error: The request could not be completed. Check your details and try again.
Auth.accountExists: This email address or nickname is already in use. Sign in to the existing profile or choose another nickname.
Auth.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
Auth.validationError: Check your details: the password must contain at least 12 characters and the nickname between 2 and 32.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
Auth.serverError: The server could not process the request. Try again after restarting the site.
Auth.networkError: The server cannot be reached. Make sure npm run dev is running.
Auth.bilingual: Full support for Ukrainian and English
Auth.privacy: We never show email addresses in leaderboards and collect only necessary data.
